links.outcome: Subgroup fairness metrics and overall F1 after synthetic-data bias mitigation in mortality prediction
links.effect: F1 improved by up to 21% averaged across downstream models; improved for every subgroup; gap between subgroup performances shrank; both fairness metrics improved in all four setups.
links.quote: It achieves this across every subgroup while simultaneously shrinking the gap between different subgroup performances, as demonstrated through the universal improvement of a pair of fairness metrics across four different experimental setups.

links.outcome: Performance for underrepresented groups after augmenting with synthetic data to remediate representation
links.effect: Synthetic data bolstering underrepresented populations improved F1 by up to 21% overall and across every subgroup, with smaller subgroup performance gaps.
links.quote: We showcase that FairPlay can improve the performance of mortality prediction both overall and across multiple different groups.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-generated synthetic patient data to balance training datasets and improve rare-outcome prediction

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM-based synthetic data generation (FairPlay) as a balancing safeguard/mitigation technique to improve equity and performance in predictive models.
